name: 16150 · Sharpsville, PA
findings: ZIP 16150 (Sharpsville) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16150 (Sharpsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
